summary.text: Brianna Lueck is the Democratic candidate for Maine House of Representatives District 79 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her campaign website describes her as a farmer and mortgage lender raised in Sumner.

paragraphs.text: Lueck writes on her campaign website, where she uses the name Brianna Fern Lueck, that she was raised in Sumner in the farmhouse her mother grew up in and graduated from Buckfield Jr.-Sr. High School and Oxford Hills Technical School in 2012.
She describes herself as a farmer and a mortgage lender with more than a decade of experience, and says she was a registered independent for many years.
Lueck advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.

Her site lists lowering the property tax burden, advocating for the district's share of state funding, protecting earned benefits and supporting schools, local businesses and family farms among her priorities for District 79, which it lists as Paris, West Paris, Woodstock, South Paris and Sumner.
